DeployedModel.title: DeployedModel
DeployedModel.description: Represents a private cloud-hosted uncensored, weighted, or abliterated LLM instance managed in the Model Management Dashboard.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the model owner.

name.description: Display name of the deployed model instance.

provider.description: Cloud compute provider hosting the model.

endpointUrl.description: Private REST/Serverless endpoint URL for inference.

gpuTier.description: Provisioned GPU hardware tier (e.g., 2x NVIDIA A100 80GB SXM).

quantization.description: Weight quantization format (e.g., EXL2 6.0bpw, AWQ 4-bit, GGUF Q6_K).

abliterationLayerRange.description: Transformer layers modified or adapter spec.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the deployed model.

activeWorkers.description: Number of currently running GPU workers.

vramUsedGb.description: Currently utilized GPU VRAM in gigabytes.

vramTotalGb.description: Total allocated GPU VRAM capacity in gigabytes.

isSelected.description: Whether this model is selected as the active target for live duplex voice conversations.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the model deployment was created (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the model deployment was last updated (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/deployed_models/{modelId.description: Per-user collection of deployed private cloud models managed in the Model Management Dashboard.
